provenance.note: Floors are half the observed values: this is a not-broken gate, not a performance benchmark. Decode throughput came in at 612.5, 613.9 and 612.3 tok/s across three runs of this prompt set on the same hardware, so the floor has wide margin and only trips on a collapse -- a CPU fallback, or a recompile every step. Re-record with --record after an intentional change to the prompt set or the serving path.
